faulty-product.name: Faulty Product
faulty-product.description: Issues involving defective, damaged, unsafe, poor-quality, or incorrectly supplied products. You can complain directly to the seller/company or via the National Consumer Helpline portal.
what_you_need: Proof of purchase (receipt, invoice, order confirmation)
Product details (brand, model, serial number, colour)
Evidence of damage (photos/videos of the defect)
Warranty card (physical or digital)
Your contact information

process.title: Identify the issue
process.description: Clearly identify the defect or problem with the product.

process.title: Collect documents
process.description: Keep the bill, warranty, order details, photographs and other relevant evidence.

process.title: Contact the seller or manufacturer
process.description: Ask the seller or manufacturer to resolve the issue through repair, replacement or refund.

process.title: Escalate if unresolved
process.description: If the issue is not resolved, you may approach the appropriate consumer grievance mechanism.

documents.title: Purchase Bill or Invoice
documents.description: Proof of purchase showing the product, seller and transaction details.

documents.title: Warranty or Guarantee Card
documents.description: Warranty or guarantee documents provided with the product.

documents.title: Photographs or Videos
documents.description: Visual evidence clearly showing the defect or damage.

documents.title: Communication Records
documents.description: Emails, messages or letters exchanged with the seller or manufacturer.

remedies.title: Refund
remedies.description: Full or partial refund of the amount paid for the product.

remedies.title: Repair
remedies.description: Free repair of the defective product.

remedies.title: Replacement
remedies.description: Replacement of the product with a new one of the same type.

remedies.title: Compensation
remedies.description: Compensation for any loss or damage caused due to the defect.

laws.text: Provides protection to consumers against defective goods and establishes mechanisms for dispute redressal.
Contains provisions relating to the quality, fitness and sale of goods.

sample_letter.subject: Complaint Regarding Faulty / Defective Product – Request for Refund / Replacement
sample_letter.body:
To,
The Grievance Redressal Officer
[Company / Seller Name]
[Company Address]

Subject: Complaint Regarding Faulty / Defective Product – Order/Invoice No. [Order/Invoice Number]

Respected Sir/Madam,

I am writing to formally lodge a complaint regarding a faulty product that I purchased from your company.

The details of the purchase and the issue are as follows:

• Product Name          : [Product Name]
• Brand / Model         : [Brand Name / Model Number]
• Order / Invoice No.   : [Order or Invoice Number]
• Date of Purchase      : [Date of Purchase]
• Amount Paid           : ₹[Amount]
• Mode of Purchase      : [Online / Offline – Store Name]

Description of the Problem:
I received the above-mentioned product on [Delivery Date]. Upon unpacking and using the product, I found that it is defective / damaged / not working properly. The specific issues are:

1. [Clearly describe the defect – e.g., the product does not switch on, screen is cracked, motor is making noise, etc.]
2. [Any other problem observed]

I have attached the following supporting documents for your reference:
• Copy of Invoice / Bill
• Photographs / Video of the defective product
• Warranty Card (if applicable)
• Order confirmation / Payment receipt

I had already contacted your customer care on [Date] (Ticket No. [if any]), but the issue has not been resolved satisfactorily till date.

As the product is defective and does not match the quality promised, I request you to kindly take the following action at the earliest:

☐ Full Refund of ₹[Amount]
☐ Replacement with a new product of the same model
☐ Free Repair under warranty

I request you to resolve this matter within 7–10 working days. If I do not receive a satisfactory response, I will be constrained to escalate the complaint to the National Consumer Helpline / Consumer Forum under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

Thanking you,

Yours faithfully,

[Your Full Name]
[Your Full Address]
Mobile: [Your Mobile Number]
Email: [Your Email Address]
Date: [Today’s Date]

service-deficiency.name: Service Deficiency
service-deficiency.description: Issues arising from inadequate, delayed, incomplete or deficient services provided by a company or professional.
what_you_need: Proof of transaction (receipts, invoices, booking confirmations)
Service agreement / contract / warranty cards
Payment proof (bank statements, UPI screenshots, credit card bills)
Written complaints, chat transcripts, call logs, and company responses
Formal written complaint with your details, opposite party details, facts (with dates), and demanded relief

process.title: Identify the deficiency
process.description: Record what service was promised and how the actual service fell short.

process.title: Collect documents
process.description: Keep agreements, invoices, receipts, work orders and all related communications.

process.title: Contact the service provider
process.description: Raise the issue with the service provider and request a suitable resolution.

process.title: Escalate if unresolved
process.description: If the service provider does not resolve the issue, use the appropriate consumer grievance mechanism.

documents.title: Service Agreement / Contract
documents.description: Written agreement or terms that specify the service to be provided.

documents.title: Invoice or Payment Receipt
documents.description: Proof of payment made for the service.

documents.title: Communication Records
documents.description: Emails, chats, letters or call records with the service provider.

documents.title: Evidence of Deficiency
documents.description: Photos, videos, screenshots or reports showing the poor or incomplete service.

remedies.title: Refund
remedies.description: Refund of the amount paid for the deficient service.

remedies.title: Re-performance of Service
remedies.description: The service provider may be directed to perform the service again properly.

remedies.title: Compensation
remedies.description: Compensation for loss, inconvenience or additional expenses caused.

laws.text: Provides protection against deficiency in services and establishes mechanisms for consumer dispute redressal.

sample_letter.subject: Complaint Regarding Deficiency in Service – Request for Refund / Compensation
sample_letter.body:
To,
The Grievance Redressal Officer
[Company / Service Provider Name]
[Company Address]

Subject: Complaint Regarding Deficiency in Service – Reference No. [Booking/Invoice Number]

Respected Sir/Madam,

I am writing to formally lodge a complaint regarding severe deficiency in the service provided by your company.

The details are as follows:

• Service Availed        : [Name of Service]
• Booking / Invoice No.  : [Booking or Invoice Number]
• Date of Service        : [Date]
• Amount Paid            : ₹[Amount]

Description of the Deficiency:
Despite making the full payment on [Date], the service provided was incomplete / delayed / of very poor quality because:

1. [Clearly describe what went wrong – e.g., service not completed on time, poor workmanship, staff behaviour, etc.]
2. [Any other issue]

I have already raised the matter with your customer care on [Date] (Ticket/Complaint No. [if any]), but no satisfactory resolution has been provided.

I request you to kindly:

☐ Provide a full refund of ₹[Amount]
☐ Complete the service properly at the earliest
☐ Pay compensation for the inconvenience and mental agony caused

I have attached all relevant documents (invoice, payment proof, previous communications, photos/videos if any).

Please resolve this issue within 7–10 working days, failing which I shall be forced to approach the Consumer Forum under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

Thanking you,

Yours faithfully,

[Your Full Name]
[Your Full Address]
Mobile: [Your Mobile Number]
Email: [Your Email Address]
Date: [Today’s Date]

billing-fraud.name: Billing Fraud
billing-fraud.description: Problems involving incorrect, unauthorized, duplicate or misleading billing and charges. This is a serious financial scam and can be a criminal offence.
what_you_need: Identity & account details (name, contact, customer ID/account number, government ID if needed)
Disputed bill/invoice, bank/credit card statements, original agreements/receipts
Communication records (emails, chats, call logs)
Written complaint letter with timeline, exact amount, and demand for refund/cancellation

process.title: Check the bill carefully
process.description: Review the bill and identify any incorrect, duplicate or unauthorized charges.

process.title: Keep all evidence
process.description: Save bills, receipts, payment records, statements and related communications.

process.title: Raise the issue
process.description: Contact the business or service provider and request correction of the billing error.

process.title: Escalate if unresolved
process.description: If the issue remains unresolved, use an appropriate grievance or consumer forum mechanism (bank charge dispute, company grievance officer, consumer forums, cyber police if online scam).

documents.title: Original Bill / Invoice
documents.description: The bill that contains the disputed or incorrect charges.

documents.title: Payment Proof
documents.description: Bank statements, UPI receipts or payment confirmations.

documents.title: Communication Records
documents.description: Emails or messages sent to the company regarding the billing issue.

documents.title: Previous Bills (if any)
documents.description: Earlier correct bills for comparison.

remedies.title: Refund of Excess Amount
remedies.description: Refund of any excess or unauthorized amount charged.

remedies.title: Correction of Bill
remedies.description: Correction of the bill and issuance of a revised statement.

remedies.title: Compensation
remedies.description: Compensation for any financial loss or hardship caused by the incorrect billing.

laws.text: Protects consumers against unfair trade practices including incorrect or misleading billing.

where_to_file: Bank/Credit Card Company (charge dispute or billing error)
Cyber Crime / Police (if identity theft or online scam)

sample_letter.subject: Complaint Regarding Billing Fraud / Incorrect Charges – Request for Immediate Refund
sample_letter.body:
To,
The Grievance Redressal Officer
[Company / Service Provider Name]
[Company Address]

Subject: Complaint Regarding Billing Fraud / Incorrect / Unauthorized Charges – Bill No. [Bill Number]

Respected Sir/Madam,

I am writing to formally complain about incorrect / unauthorized / fraudulent charges levied by your company.

The details are as follows:

• Account / Customer ID  : [Your Account or Customer ID]
• Bill / Invoice Number  : [Bill Number]
• Bill Date              : [Date of Bill]
• Disputed Amount        : ₹[Amount]

Nature of the Fraud / Error:
The bill contains the following incorrect / unauthorized charges:

1. [Describe the wrong charge – e.g., charged for services not availed, duplicate charges, inflated amount, etc.]
2. [Any other discrepancy]

I have never authorized these charges. I have attached the following documents:
• Copy of the disputed bill
• Bank / Credit Card statement showing the deduction
• Previous correct bills (for comparison)
• All previous communications with your team

I request you to immediately:

☐ Cancel the fraudulent / incorrect charges
☐ Refund the excess amount of ₹[Amount] to my account
☐ Issue a corrected bill

Please resolve this matter within 7 working days. If no satisfactory action is taken, I will escalate the matter to the Consumer Forum / Cyber Crime Cell / Police under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

Thanking you,

Yours faithfully,

[Your Full Name]
[Your Full Address]
Mobile: [Your Mobile Number]
Email: [Your Email Address]
Date: [Today’s Date]

Lays down duties of e-commerce entities and marketplace sellers.

banking-financial.name: Banking / Financial
banking-financial.description: Consumer issues involving banking or financial services, unauthorized transactions, charges, loans, cards, accounts and other banking-related deficiencies.
what_you_need: Personal & account details (full name, account number, Customer ID/CIF, registered mobile & email)
Transaction details (date & time, amount, transaction ID/reference number, beneficiary details if applicable)
Supporting documents (bank statement/passbook with highlight, screenshots, ATM/merchant receipts, previous communications)

process.title: Record the transaction
process.description: Note the date, amount, reference number, account details and exact nature of the problem.

process.title: Collect documents
process.description: Keep account statements, transaction receipts, SMS alerts, emails and any related correspondence.

process.title: Contact the bank / provider
process.description: Raise a formal complaint through the bank’s grievance redressal system or customer care (toll-free, branch, or mobile app).

process.title: Escalate if unresolved
process.description: Escalate step-by-step: Grievance Redressal Officer (GRO) → Principal Nodal Officer (PNO) → RBI Banking Ombudsman (cms.rbi.org.in) if no reply within 30 days or unsatisfactory response.

documents.title: Bank Statement / Passbook
documents.description: Relevant account statement showing the disputed transaction or charge.

documents.title: Transaction Receipt / SMS Alert
documents.description: Confirmation SMS, email or receipt of the transaction in question.

documents.title: Complaint Acknowledgement
documents.description: Copy of the complaint lodged with the bank and any reference number given.

documents.title: Related Documents
documents.description: Loan agreement, card statements or any other supporting papers.

remedies.title: Refund / Reversal
remedies.description: Refund or reversal of unauthorized or excess amount charged.

remedies.title: Correction of Records
remedies.description: Correction of account records and statements.

remedies.title: Compensation
remedies.description: Compensation for financial loss and mental harassment.

laws.text: Applies to banking and financial services as ‘services’ under the Act.
Provides an alternative grievance redressal mechanism for banking customers.

[Bank Name]
[Branch Address / Head Office Address]

Respected Sir/Madam,

I am a customer of your bank holding Account No. [Your Account Number] (Customer ID / CIF: [CIF Number]).

I wish to lodge a formal complaint regarding the following issue:

• Date & Time of Transaction : [Date and Time]
• Transaction Amount         : ₹[Amount]
• Transaction ID / UTR       : [Transaction Reference Number]
• Nature of Problem          : [Unauthorized transaction / Wrong charges / Failed transaction but amount debited / etc.]

Description:
[Clearly explain what happened – e.g., money was debited without my authorization, double deduction, service not provided but charged, etc.]

I have already reported this issue to customer care on [Date] (Complaint/Ticket No. [if any]), but no satisfactory resolution has been received.

I request you to kindly:

☐ Immediately reverse / refund the amount of ₹[Amount]
☐ Correct my account records
☐ Provide compensation for the mental harassment and financial loss caused

I have attached:
• Bank statement highlighting the disputed transaction
• SMS / Email alerts
• Screenshots of the transaction
• Copy of previous complaint

Please resolve this matter urgently. If not resolved within the stipulated time, I will escalate the complaint to the Principal Nodal Officer and thereafter to the RBI Banking Ombudsman (cms.rbi.org.in).

Thanking you,

Yours faithfully,

[Your Full Name]
Account No.: [Your Account Number]
Mobile: [Your Registered Mobile Number]
Email: [Your Registered Email]
